correctness.rationale: Expanding L=D-A by walk length, the diagonal of L^3 is d^3+2d^2+s, an edge has L^3 entry -(d^2+de+e^2+d+e-1) (the three-edge walks number d+e-1), a distance-two entry is the sum of the three degrees, and a distance-three entry is -1; longer entries vanish. The L^2 entries are respectively d^2+d, -(d+e), 1, and 0. The edge quadratic has positive leading coefficient and negative discriminant, since d^2+de+e^2 >= 3(d+e)^2/4. The diagonal is strictly decreasing by s>=d and 1-z+z^2/2>0. Thus only a diagonal or distance-two entry can go negative at a positive step, proving the closed single interval. The identity with F=I-hL, P=I/3+F/2+F^3/6, leaves diagonal slack at h=1/Delta; equality requires a two-edge path of three vertices of full degree, and attaching leaves to a three-hub path realizes it for every Delta>=2. For the star, substitution at 3/(Delta+2) gives the displayed negative expression: its numerator 4Delta^3+3Delta^2-9Delta-16 is positive at 2 and increasing thereafter. At its smaller center root the row-sum identity gives symmetric center-leaf entries 1/Delta. The leaf-to-leaf cubic c is bounded by 2/[3(Delta+2)^2]<1/Delta (maximum at h=2/(Delta+2)); hence the leaf diagonal is positive there. A full-degree vertex in a nonstar has s>Delta, so its diagonal is strictly negative at the star root. All conclusions are for the completed step; graph work is linear, apart from the stated precision-dependent scalar root work. The finite script was inspected but not executed; no enumeration is needed for the arbitrary-tree proof.

originality.rationale: Distinct published Resultary records give the exact positivity formula on all positively weighted bipartite graphs and the exact hub cutoff on all positively weighted stars. The tree-local test is an exact specialization of the first; the full-degree equality motif and unique upper extremizer follow directly from these exact formulas, the forward-Euler identity, and the observation that a full-degree vertex all of whose neighbors are leaves forces a star. This is demonstrable mathematical coverage, not a historical priority finding: the strongest records are catalogued after the frozen date.

value.rationale: An exact completed-step positivity cutoff on a natural graph class is useful in its own right: it replaces a matrix check with local degree data and decides when the forward-Euler constraint is sharp. The fixed-degree extremal interpretation is meaningful numerically and structurally. This assessment of the mathematics does not make an already covered specialization an independently distinct contribution.
